text:
miriam: FYI — after last night's kernel selection tweak, dashboards show a token-level latency step on /generate P95. looks tied to KV cache misses.

devin: seen it too. small sample from profiling: kernel switch introduced an extra copy on cache miss path. profiling traces attached in thread.

sam: can you paste the token-level query you used? want to compare with our per-route KPIs.

miriam: query I used (Grafana/Loki):
```\nsum(rate(token_latency_ms_bucket{route=\"/generate\",le!=\"+Inf\"}[5m])) by (le)\n```
then converted to histogram to inspect per-token delta.

nina: interesting — our StatsD emitter shows intermittent UDP drops around 03:12 UTC which lines up with the latency bump. suspect exporter batching + kernel change amplified backpressure.

devin: i dug into the runtime logs. kernel selection path will now attempt fast-fallback -> fallback kernel when sequence_len>512. on a cache miss we do an extra prefetch and serialize call which adds ~10-15ms per token.

sam: timeline check: kernel change deployed 02:58 UTC (deploy-bot confirmed). metric drop window 03:10–03:18. are we missing metrics between runtime -> statsd -> otel bridge?

deploy-bot: deploy accepted: "kernel-selection-v3" by devops at 2026-01-15T02:58:12Z.

miriam: ingest-bot logs: OTEL exporter returned 5xx retries in bursts. snippet:
```\nERROR exporter: failed to push metrics: 503 Service Unavailable\n  attempts=3, last_error=\"timeout\"\n```
so two issues: metrics dropped while latency rose. bad for alerting.

nina: Ops hypothesis: exporter backpressure + StatsD batching meant many token-level buckets were aggregated or lost. the histogram cardinality increased post-change (new tag kernel=fast-fallback), which stressed the emitter.

ops-oncall: is there an alert for sudden decrease in metric volume? we didn't get alert because our threshold was total packets, not unique metric series.

sam: short-term mitigation: roll back kernel-selection-v3 or disable the new kernel tag so cardinality doesn't spike. long-term: make StatsD/OTel emitter resilient to series explosions and add backfill pipeline for dropped token buckets.

devin: i have a minimal repro: run with sequence_len distrib that forces fast-fallback, enable KV cache miss path, stream 1000 concurrent requests. will run and attach profiling flamegraphs.

miriam: also we need dashboard changes: token-level latency breakdown panel should include metric counts and missing-bucket anomaly so we detect drop vs real perf regression. add a panel that shows statsd_packets_in vs unique_series_count.

nina: created a Grafana panel mock: https://grafana.company/redwood/d/abc123/token-latency?orgId=1 (mock link) — shows series explosion at 03:00 and packet drops at 03:12.

devin: quick mitigation plan:
- revert kernel-selection-v3 (if rollback acceptable)
- patch emitter to drop high-cardinality tags by sampling (drop kernel tag)
- run a targeted backfill for dropped histograms using request logs -> regenerate histograms and push via otel/importer

sam: about backfill — we need a safe plan: backfill must be idempotent, and we must mark backfilled series in dashboards. suggest we run in canary on a subset of routes (/generate only) and surface differences.

miriam: agree. i'll own the rollback decision. if rollback would cause functional regressions, we prefer emitter patch + backfill. can we triage now?

devin: rollback impact: no model behavior change, only kernel heuristics tuned for cost. rollback is safe and will revert perf to baseline. if we rollback, metrics will stabilize quickly and backfill can run afterwards.

nina: backfill approach: replay logs -> reconstruct token_histogram per minute per route -> push via otel metrics importer with tag backfill=true. script roughly:
```\nfor minute in minutes: reconstruct_histogram(minute) | otelcli push --metric token_latency_histogram --labels route=/generate,backfill=true\n```
We must rate-limit the importer to avoid another overload.

ops-oncall: can we add a short-term alert now: if unique_series_count increases > 3x in 5m and packet_error_rate > 1% then page eng-runtime.

sam: i'll add the alert rule and a runbook entry for backfill. also add a check in the emitter: if unique_series_count crosses 5000, start sampling high-card tags.

miriam: timeline:
- 03:30: decision to rollback (if rollback chosen)
- 03:35: rollback or emitter patch deploy canary
- 04:00: backfill job (canary) start

devin: running repro now. attaching flamegraph link in thread once done.

miriam: thanks. once we stabilize, we should run a controlled experiment: enable kernel-selection-v3 behind route flag, shard emitter to isolated pipeline, and run load test to measure delta in token-latency and metric emission.

nina: noted. will prepare isolation plan for emitter and add telemetry for series cardinality per route.

ops-oncall: created incident ticket INC-2026-142 in PagerDuty and set priority P2.

ingest-bot: metrics ingest window: 03:00:00–03:30:00 had ~12% lower metric counts vs expected, 1.8% 5xx from otel-collector.

miriam: great thread. action items: rollback decision (miriam), run repro + flamegraphs (devin), add alert + sampling patch (sam), backfill plan + rate limits (nina), incident updates in ticket INC-2026-142.

devin: flamegraph uploaded: https://internal-storage/redwood/flame/1815002468-ff.svg

sam: alert rule added and muted for test window. will post the link.

miriam: i'll start rollback now and update thread with timestamps.

deploy-bot: started rollback: kernel-selection-v2 by miriam at 2026-01-15T03:31:05Z.

miriam: rollback completed. initial dashboards look better — token P95 dropped ~9ms. we'll keep monitoring and run backfill tomorrow. thanks all. :thumbsup:
